*Arūpāvacaraduka, Kusalattika* (Patthana 15.65) is an Abhidhamma text belonging to the *Paṭṭhāna*, the final book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka. Structurally, it treats the conditional relations of phenomena through the analytical matrix combining the immaterial-sphere dyad (*arūpāvacaraduka*) with the wholesome triad (*kusalattika*).

 However, computational analysis by DharmaNexus shows extensive internal text reuse across the Abhidhamma, registering 85 matching passages across 30 other Pali texts [DharmaNexus]. DharmaNexus also records weak cross-language machine alignments with the Tibetan translation of the *Karmaprajñapti* (*Las gdags pa*, D4088), although these represent low-confidence textual resemblances rather than direct historical parallels [DharmaNexus].
